current.title: The Golden Rickshaw
current.logline: A struggling rickshaw driver finds a heavy bag of gold coins and must choose between sudden wealth and his own honesty.

parts.title: The Golden Rickshaw: A Driver's Choice | Pt 1/3
parts.hook_text: A heavy secret waits in the rain.
parts.description: Jian pedals through a neon-lit rainy city and discovers a mysterious leather pouch filled with gold coins on his rickshaw seat.
parts.caption: A heavy secret waits in the rain. Part 1/3 — save this so you don't miss the next part. What would you do with a bag of gold found in your cab? #Gold #Mystery #StoryTime #RainyNight

panels.image_prompt: A futuristic city street at night under heavy rain, neon signs reflecting in puddles, upper 25% empty dark sky, wide cinematic shot, vibrant cyan and magenta lighting, tense mood
panels.lighting: vibrant cyan and magenta neon glow
panels.narration: A heavy secret waits in the rain.

dialogue.speaker: Jian
dialogue.line: A heavy secret waits in the rain.

panels.sfx: Pattering rain and distant traffic hum

panels.image_prompt: Jian pedaling a bicycle rickshaw hard down a wet alleyway, water splashing from wheels, upper 25% dark wet brick wall, medium action shot, moody street lamps, exhausting effort
panels.narration: Jian pedals through the cold city. The rain falls harder.

panels.image_prompt: Neon signs blurred in the rainy night, empty asphalt street, upper 25% dark gloomy sky, low angle close-up, dim amber lighting, lonely atmosphere
panels.narration: The streets empty out. Every passenger has gone home.

panels.image_prompt: Jian pulling the rickshaw to a stop beneath a glowing billboard, wiping sweat from his brow, upper 25% glowing neon sign, medium close-up, tired expression
panels.narration: Jian pulls over to catch his breath.

dialogue.speaker: Jian
dialogue.line: Just a few more miles to go.

panels.image_prompt: A dark leather pouch resting on the vinyl seat of the rickshaw, wet drops glistening on the leather, upper 25% dark empty background, close-up shot, dramatic spotlight
panels.narration: A heavy leather pouch rests on the back seat.

panels.image_prompt: Jian turning around from the handlebars to look closely at the back seat, upper 25% dark alley shadows, over-the-shoulder medium shot, cool blue tones, curious expression
panels.narration: Someone left something behind.

dialogue.speaker: Jian
dialogue.line: What is this?

panels.image_prompt: Jian's hands untying a thick leather drawstring on the pouch, upper 25% dark interior of the rickshaw, extreme close-up, moody shadow lighting, suspenseful mood
panels.narration: Jian's fingers pull the cord.

panels.image_prompt: Jian gasping as a blinding golden glow shines upward from an open pouch onto his face, upper 25% brilliant warm golden light casting shadows, close-up shot, shocked expression
panels.narration: Jian pulls the drawstring of the pouch and gasps at the blinding glow of pure gold inside.

dialogue.speaker: Jian
dialogue.line: It's... real gold.

parts.title: Gold Coins in the Cab | Pt 2/3
parts.previously: Jian found a heavy bag of gold coins hidden inside his rickshaw.
parts.description: Jian tries to work through the rain while hiding the heavy bag of gold coins, but a sharp passenger boards and starts asking dangerous questions.
parts.caption: Is this real gold? Part 2/3 — save this so you don't miss the next part. What would you do with a bag of gold? #story #gold #choices #drama

panels.image_prompt: Empty neon alleyway at night, upper 25% dark rain clouds, close-up shot of a leather pouch spilling glowing coins, bright warm golden light, shocked
panels.narration: Jian stares at the bright treasure in his hands.

dialogue.speaker: Jian
dialogue.line: Is this real gold?

panels.image_prompt: Busy wet city street at night, upper 25% neon signs reflecting in puddles, wide shot of Jian pedaling his rickshaw fast, determined
panels.narration: He hides the bag under his seat and pedals into the rain.

panels.image_prompt: Street corner under a glowing noodle shop sign, upper 25% dark sky, medium shot of Jian wiping sweat from his forehead, anxious
panels.narration: Every shadow looks like a thief. His hands shake on the bars.

dialogue.speaker: Jian
dialogue.line: Keep moving. Just drive.

panels.image_prompt: Wet sidewalk outside a luxury hotel, upper 25% glowing hotel canopy, medium shot of Mei holding a silk umbrella, demanding expression
panels.narration: A wealthy passenger steps out from the shadows and signals him down.

dialogue.speaker: Mei
dialogue.line: Take me to the station now.

panels.image_prompt: Inside the covered rickshaw cabin, upper 25% dark roof canvas, close-up of Mei sitting upright, sharp and suspicious expression
panels.narration: Mei climbs inside and the heavy gold bag shifts beneath the seat cushion.

dialogue.speaker: Mei
dialogue.line: Drive carefully. I lost something very precious today.

panels.image_prompt: Rickshaw seat close-up, upper 25% dark cushions, tight shot of the leather pouch strap sticking out from the cushion, tense
panels.narration: The gold bag peeks out. Jian's heart leaps into his throat.

panels.image_prompt: Wet rainy street, upper 25% dark neon lights, over-the-shoulder shot of Jian looking back toward the passenger seat, nervous
panels.narration: He grips the handlebars tighter. Sweat mixes with the rain on his face.

dialogue.speaker: Jian
dialogue.line: Did you... lose something important?

panels.image_prompt: Inside the rickshaw cabin, upper 25% dark canvas, close-up of Mei leaning forward with a piercing gaze, sharp
panels.narration: Mei looks right at Jian and asks if he found anything valuable in his cab today.

dialogue.speaker: Mei
dialogue.line: Did you find anything valuable in my cab today?

parts.title: The Golden Rickshaw: The Final Choice | Pt 3/3
parts.hook_text: I found your gold right here!
parts.previously: Jian stared at a bag of glowing gold coins while Mei turned around to ask if he found anything valuable in his cab.
parts.description: Jian battles his temptation, hands the golden pouch back to its rightful owner, and receives an honest fare that warms his heart.
parts.caption: I found your gold right here! Part 3/3 — save this so you don't miss the next part. Would you have given the gold back? #Honesty #GoldenRickshaw #StoryTime #GoodDeeds

panels.image_prompt: Busy neon street at night, Jian holding the heavy golden pouch open inside the rickshaw, upper 25% dark wet canvas top, medium eye-level shot, neon glow and warm gold light, nervous tension
panels.narration: The heavy pouch felt like a mountain in my hands.

dialogue.speaker: Jian
dialogue.line: I found your gold right here!

panels.image_prompt: Dark rainy alleyway beside the neon street, Mei turning around with a sharp stare, upper 25% empty dark brick wall, close-up shot, dramatic streetlamp lighting, curious
panels.narration: Mei turned slowly and stared into the shadows of the cab.

panels.image_prompt: Wet rickshaw seat with the heavy golden pouch resting on the cushion, upper 25% dark canvas roof, low angle close-up shot, neon pink reflection, temptation
panels.narration: Rich overnight. Just like that.

panels.image_prompt: Jian wiping sweat from his forehead inside the dark rickshaw cabin, upper 25% empty dark roof, medium close-up shot, dim amber light, conflicted
panels.narration: My hands shook. The gold could fix all my problems.

dialogue.speaker: Jian
dialogue.line: No. This is not mine to keep.

panels.image_prompt: Jian holding out the heavy golden pouch toward the passenger seat, upper 25% empty rainy sky, medium shot, bright warm gold light on hands, resolute
panels.lighting: bright warm gold light on hands
panels.narration: I pushed the heavy weight away from myself and held it out.

dialogue.speaker: Jian
dialogue.line: You dropped this in my cab.

panels.image_prompt: Mei taking the golden pouch with a warm smile on her face, upper 25% dark rainy background, close-up shot, soft glowing neon light, relieved
panels.narration: A wide smile spread across her face like the morning sun.

dialogue.speaker: Mei
dialogue.line: Thank you for your honesty.

panels.image_prompt: Mei handing a small coin to Jian in the glowing rain, upper 25% empty wet street, medium two-shot, warm golden streetlamp light, happy
panels.narration: She handed me a fair and honest coin for the ride.

dialogue.speaker: Mei
dialogue.line: You earned every bit of this.

panels.image_prompt: Jian smiling brightly while pulling his rickshaw down a sparkling rainy street, upper 25% glowing neon signs in the rain, wide angle shot, brilliant warm sunrise light breaking through clouds, peaceful
panels.lighting: brilliant warm sunrise light breaking through clouds
panels.narration: My pockets were light, but my heart was richer than gold.

current.setting: Busy rainy streets of a modern neon-lit Asian city

cast.name: Jian
cast.outfit: bright blue jacket over black shirt and grey pants
cast.accessory: thick silver bangle on left wrist
cast.visual_prompt: 35-year-old Asian male, lean build, oval face, dark brown eyes, short black buzz cut, warm tan skin, bright blue jacket, thick silver bangle on wrist.

cast.name: Mei
cast.outfit: bright green vest over white shirt and dark trousers
cast.visual_prompt: 40-year-old Asian female, sturdy build, round face, black eyes, long black braid, medium skin, bright green vest, brown leather satchel across chest.

beats.summary: Jian pedals his rickshaw through the rain. He finds a heavy leather pouch left behind on the back seat. He opens it to see it is full of gleaming gold coins.
beats.cliffhanger: Jian pulls the drawstring of the pouch and gasps at the blinding glow of pure gold inside.
beats.payoff_next: Jian stares at the glowing gold coins on his lap while the streetlights hum in the heavy rain.

beats.summary: Jian tries to continue his day, but temptation grows. A wealthy passenger, Mei, boards his rickshaw and drops a subtle hint about a lost reward, testing Jian's resolve.
beats.cliffhanger: Mei looks right at Jian and asks if he found anything valuable in his cab today.
beats.payoff_next: Jian grips the handlebars tightly, sweating under his bright blue jacket as he faces the passenger.

beats.summary: Jian fights his greed and hands the heavy pouch back to Mei. Mei smiles warmly and gives him a modest, honest fare, leaving Jian with a light heart and true wealth.

beats.summary: Bari finds a heavy leather pouch stuffed with gold coins left on his rickshaw seat by a hurried passenger. Struggling to pay for his sick daughter's medicine, he looks inside the pouch and wonders if anyone will ever know.
beats.cliffhanger: A frantic Seth rushes back to the rickshaw stand shouting about a missing fortune.
beats.payoff_next: Bari hides the gold pouch quickly under his wooden seat just as Seth grabs the handles of his rickshaw.

beats.summary: Seth hires Bari to race across the steep hill city to the harbor docks, testing Bari's patience and greed. Meera boards midway, dropping a silver coin, and Bari faces the choice to help her or hide the extra coin alongside the gold.
beats.cliffhanger: The gold pouch slips out from under the seat and rolls onto the dusty road right at Meera's feet.
beats.payoff_next: Meera picks up the heavy gold pouch with wide eyes and looks straight at Bari.

beats.summary: Bari refuses to lie, telling Meera and Seth the truth and handing back the gold pouch entirely. Seth offers a generous reward for his honesty, giving Bari enough money for the medicine without losing his peace of mind.

judge.notes: The story is engaging, beautifully paced for a vertical comic format, and hits the general audience safety guidelines perfectly. Minor note: Ensure the transition between Seth leaving and Meera boarding in Part 2 is visually smooth, as Seth originally rushed back shouting in Part 1's cliffhanger, but Part 2 immediately resumes the chase. Overall, excellent structure and clear character motivation.
